description: 1. Description of the Offer The Gauge 3D 180° is a premium custom visual for Power BI that transforms standard metric tracking into an immersive, high-fidelity three-dimensional experience. Built with a sophisticated SVG and D3.js framework, the visual incorporates realistic depth layers and dynamic lighting to simulate a physical instrument. The offer features a flexible licensing model for 1 to 99 users and includes a 30-day free trial period. During this trial, users have unrestricted access to all premium features; after 30 days, a watermark is applied while maintaining full functionality, ensuring that critical business reports remain operational while evaluation continues. 2. Target User This visual is specifically designed for Executive Leadership, BI Managers, and Data Storytellers who create high-stakes dashboards. It benefits professionals who present data in executive boardrooms, investor relations reports, or premium client-facing portals—environments where the visual impact and "perceived value" of the information must match its strategic importance. 3. Customer Needs and Pain Points * Visual Engagement Gap: Native Power BI visuals can often appear flat or generic, leading to lower engagement from senior stakeholders.
